notes: No accuracy budget changed. Results describe sampled inputs and this machine/compiler, not a full-domain or cross-platform proof.
Native FMA is compile-time specialization. The portable compensated sum is accurate for bounded solver operands, not a general correctly-rounded IEEE FMA emulator.
f64 inside endpoints use bounded six-face first-exit isolation, including any prior exit/re-entry. Outside endpoints retain the established fast upper-face refinement.
The initial candidate used bounded isolation for all f64 endpoints; it slowed the Rec.2020 outside-fold focused case by 29% and was revised before the final measurements.
